name: lufy-human-readout-screen

source.label_rule: majority vote across three binary important? annotations

candidate_family.window_operation: fit standardization separately for each output on development-train folds, then mean adjacent standardized outputs

split.user_id_rule: first 12 hex characters of SHA256('intentprobe-lufy-v1:' + user_name)
split.selection: four-fold GroupKFold on the remaining 12 users
split.test_use: one final evaluation after candidate selection

baseline: word 1-2 plus character 2-5 TF-IDF logistic trained on the same 12 development users
release_boundary: Historical LUFY annotation files remain in licence quarantine. Do not publish the human-trained numeric artifact until release rights are confirmed.
